title: Overshadowing of a narrow adjoining lot (Table 3.9b, rear half of site)
text: Notwithstanding C3.9.1, in climate zones 4, 5, and 6, where the adjoining property is: i. coded R40 or greater; and ii. has a lot frontage 7.5m or less (excluding battleaxe lots); iii. development is designed so that its shadow cast at midday, 21 June onto any other adjoining property does not exceed the limits set out in Table 3.9b.

replaces.note: R50-R60 rear half 50% -> 55%; new for single houses at R40 and below

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.9.3. Table 3.9b keyed by the adjoining lot's coding and frontage; other adjoining lots have no row (NOT_APPLICABLE, C3.9.1 governs). No limit on the front half. The C3.9.2 exemption is written against C3.9.1 only. Coding excludes R100-SL: Chapter 3 Table 2.10a (p26) removes all 3.9 provisions for R100-SL, but its footnote restores them where the development abuts a property not coded R100-SL (not encoded).
